description: A page of the history of a list, item, index or identity: what happened, when, and at which version, without snapshots (get_event has them). For an item, restorable: true lists only the events restore_item can go back to, including the item-deleted event of a deleted item; this is how to find restore points. 1 request.

index.description: The index (id or pathName), for resource "index"

item.description: The item, for resource "item". A deleted item only by id

list.description: The list (id or pathName); needed for list, item and index

resource.description: Whose history: a list, an item (needs list and item), an index (needs list and index) or an identity

restorable.description: Items only: just the events restore_item can restore

startAt.description: Only events at or after this time (ISO 8601)

type.description: Only events of this type: list-created, list-updated, list-deleted, item-created, item-updated, item-restored, item-deleted, index-created, index-updated, index-deleted, index-built, index-build-failed, index-build-requested, or an identity event type

name: list_events
title: List events
